comparison.objective: Perform gold lift-off and ordered solvent rinses while catching waste.
comparison.physical_skill: Move a wafer cassette through labeled baths while coordinating a drip dish and waste pour.
comparison.success_condition: Correct bath order and dwell, cassette left in DI water, caught waste emptied, no contamination, spill or wafer contact.
comparison.reason: It is process sequencing and contamination-safe liquid handling; it does not physically screen two intermixed rigid populations.
